mainEntity.name: What Does IP69K Mean and Why Does It Matter for Washdown Conveyors?

acceptedAnswer.text: IP69K is an ingress protection rating for equipment exposed to close-range, high-pressure, high-temperature water jets, which is what motors, sensors and connectors in the spray path face during every washdown. It matters because a component that lets water in fails early and stops the line. On TRFCleanflow Washdown, IP66 / IP69K components in direct washdown zones are a design target, confirmed per project.

mainEntity.name: What Is a NEMA 4X Enclosure and When Is It Required?

acceptedAnswer.text: A NEMA 4X enclosure protects electrical equipment against hose-directed water, splashing and corrosion. A NEMA 4X control enclosure is a design target on TRFCleanflow Washdown, with the enclosure location defined in the project layout.

mainEntity.name: What Is the Difference Between 304 and 316 Stainless Steel in Conveyor Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both are stainless grades used in food equipment. Grade 304 is the common choice for sanitary construction, and 316 offers higher corrosion resistance where the product or the cleaning chemicals are harder on the steel. TRFCleanflow Washdown has 304 stainless-steel sanitary construction as its design target, with 316 as an option for aggressive environments, chosen per project.

mainEntity.name: What Is a Washdown-Rated Motor and Gearbox?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a drive built to withstand frequent spraying with water and cleaning chemicals, with sealed housings and surfaces that shed water instead of holding it. On a washdown conveyor, drives often sit in the direct spray path. Washdown-duty motors and gearboxes are a design target on TRFCleanflow Washdown, selected for the zone where each drive is installed.

mainEntity.name: How Often Does a Sanitary Conveyor Need to Be Washed Down?

acceptedAnswer.text: The plant's sanitation program sets the frequency, not the conveyor. Zones that handle animal protein and similar exposed products are typically sanitized daily with chemicals, high pressure and high temperature, while dry zones for industrialized foods are cleaned moderately and infrequently. TRFCleanflow Washdown is designed for frequent washdown environments, with the cleaning routine set by your sanitation program.
